text:
alina: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need to finalize the status page copy, customer-facing summary, and the RCA access playbook. Legal raised concerns about leaked traces. Assigning owners now.

marc: I can take the statuspage short copy. Will post a short, plain-language draft in 2h.

rachel: I'll own the customer summary + email template. Plan: timeline, impact, mitigation, prevention work, and a "who to contact" line.

dave: Ops note: recurring eviction spikes 1 incidents referencing token-cache behavior across last 8 weeks. Need an owner + ticket + detection rule so this isn't a recurring postmortem. I can open the remediation ticket.

legal-team: Legal: public-facing should be a "technical summary" only. Don't include raw request text, IPs, or unredacted traces. If a customer requests the full RCA with logs, require CSM vet + signed consent/NDA.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-212 026-01-18 09:42 UTC 0assigned to @alina

alina: Marc, paste your draft here when ready. Rachel, target for customer email by Thu EOD? Dave, open remediation ticket with acceptance criteria and ETA.

marc: Draft statuspage copy:
```
Status: Partial degradation of text-generation API.
Impact: increased latencies and transient 5xx errors for a subset of requests between 02:1502:40 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated 0we rolled back the recent deploy and are monitoring.
Next steps: We will publish a technical summary on the status page and a customer-facing summary by <date>.
```
Thoughts?

rachel: Good. Add: "Data integrity: no customer data was modified or lost." Add a short bullet: "Affected customers will be contacted proactively." Also include link to support contact.

alina: Policy decision: public technical summary on status page + offer full internal RCA to affected enterprise customers on request. Require CSM approval and a consent form/NDA for logs/traces. Owners: marc (status copy), rachel (customer summary + consent language), dave (remediation ticket + detection rule). Deadlines: status copy today, customer summary Thu EOD, remediation ticket within 48h.

dave: Created INF-4477 "token-cache: eviction guardrails and detection" (owner: dave). ETA: 3 weeks. Acceptance criteria: (1) eviction detection alert fires after 3 evictions in 15m, (2) automated safeguard reduces eviction rate by 80% in load tests, (3) docs for runbook. I'll attach the Grafana rule.

rachel: I'll draft the customer email template + a consent checkbox for full-RCA access (minimal wording) and post by Thu EOD. Sample line: "We can provide a full internal technical report on request; please coordinate with your CSM and sign a consent form to receive redacted logs/traces."

legal-team: Will review final drafts. Prefer phrase: "technical summary" instead of "RCA" in public posts.

alina: Async sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to review drafts. Final action items I'm locking in here:
- Statuspage copy (owner: marc) 0draft today
- Customer-facing summary + email template + consent copy (owner: rachel) 0due Thu EOD
- RCA access playbook & consent wording (owner: rachel, legal consult) 0due Thu EOD
- Remediation ticket + detection rule (owner: dave) 0created INF-4477, ETA 3w
- Outreach list for affected customers (owner: cs-team) 0proactive reach by Fri

marc: ack :thumbsup:

rachel: ack, will post drafts here.

alina: I'll update the incident board and move tasks to the comms lane. If no objections by 11:30 tomorrow I'll publish the status draft to staging for legal review. :rocket:
